_doc: Med Scheduler timing rules. 'find' must match the named US label (dosage and administration, drug interactions or renal impairment section) verbatim; build_timing.py copies the matched sentence as the source quote. meal: with | before (before meals) | empty (empty stomach) | after (after meals); tod: morning | evening | bedtime; hd: unit (given at the dialysis unit) | after (after dialysis on dialysis days) | any; slot: preferred anchor (PB pre-breakfast, B, L, D, HS). 'separations' are taken from APPROVED interaction rows (owner slug + the row's drug_or_class prefix): before = minimum hours when the owner drug is taken before the partner, after = when taken after; null = that order is not allowed. 'practice' entries are prescriber practice defaults supplied by Dr. Rivero (not label text); they set the time of day and are shown as practice, never as a label quote. A label rule for the same molecule keeps its quote.

rules.label: sevelamer
rules.find: three times per day with meals

rules.label: cinacalcet
rules.find: taken with food or shortly after a meal

rules.label: levothyroxine
rules.find: on an empty stomach, one-half to one hour before breakfast

rules.label: glimepiride
rules.find: with breakfast or the first main meal

rules.label: glipizide
rules.find: with breakfast or the first main meal
rules.note: Extended-release label; immediate-release glipizide is usually taken 30 minutes before a meal.

rules.label: allopurinol
rules.find: better tolerated if taken following meals

rules.label: prednisone
rules.find: should be taken daily with food

rules.label: isoniazid
rules.find: should not be administered with food

rules.label: tacrolimus
rules.note: Take consistently with or without food.

rules.label: ciclosporin
rules.find: consistent schedule with regard to time of day and relation to meals
rules.note: Keep a consistent time and relation to meals.

rules.label: spironolactone
rules.note: Take consistently with respect to food.

rules.label: epoetin-alfa
rules.find: intravenous route is recommended for patients on hemodialysis

rules.label: methoxy-polyethylene-glycol-epoetin-beta
rules.find: intravenous route is recommended for patients receiving hemodialysis

rules.label: pregabalin
rules.find: supplemental dose immediately following every 4-hour hemodialysis

rules.label: tramadol
rules.find: regular dose on the day of dialysis

rules.label: sitagliptin
rules.find: without regard to the timing of dialysis

practice.note: Bedtime by local practice, to limit stomach upset.
